ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs From Uncommon Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities from a potentially suspicious location

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\Regsvcs\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Regasm\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "RegSvcs\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "RegAsm\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Start\\ Menu\\\\Programs\\\\Startup\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
